Therefore each single other kind of animal is found in the village. And what is killed in the wilderness they bring to the village. Having praised, they run back. They thereby send the sacrificer to the heavenly world. They raise their arms. They thereby establish the sacrificer in the heavenly world. But they indeed do something untrue, those who send a mortal to immortality. They become diminished in form and splendor. Now, if another who knows thus should rise up, one should rise up grasping him as he rises. One does not become diminished in form and splendor, nor does one come to harm. One should discern what is about to happen. If the creatures should appear as if agitated, the livelihood will be agitated. One should know: 'Thus has this udgatr chanted.' If they should appear as if calm, the livelihood will be calm. One should know: 'Thus has this udgatr chanted.'

1.89.s: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ iti grtāmakāmo bhūtikāmaḥ prajananakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . asyai vāvedam upagāyanti . upa vāvedam asyāṃ sarvam upaivāsyāṃ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate ya evaṃ veda . naro ha vai devaviśaḥ kṣatraṃ soma induḥ . viśaṃ caivaitena kṣatraṃ cāvarunddhe . abhi devaṃ iyakṣate iti sarvā evaitena devatā anantarāyam abhiyajate . upo ṣu jātam apturam iti prajākāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . upeva vā ātman prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate . etāṃ evāparedyuḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . apturam iti hy asyā āptvā śreyāṃsaṃ vasīyān ātmanā bhavati . gobhir bhaṅgaṃ pariṣkṛtam iti . yajño vai gobhir bhaṅgaḥ paśavaḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ . yajñaṃ caivaitena paśūṃś cāvarunddhe . induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ iti . yajamāno vai somo rājendus stomā devāḥ .
1.89.d: उपास्मै गायता नरः इति ग्र्तामकामो भूतिकामः प्रजननकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . अस्यै वावेदम् उपगायन्ति . उप वावेदम् अस्यां सर्वम् उपैवास्यां प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते य एवं वेद . नरो ह वै देवविशः क्षत्रं सोम इन्दुः . विशं चैवैतेन क्षत्रं चावरुन्द्धे . अभि देवं इयक्षते इति सर्वा एवैतेन देवता अनन्तरायम् अभियजते . उपो षु जातम् अप्तुरम् इति प्रजाकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . उपेव वा आत्मन् प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते . एतां एवापरेद्युः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . अप्तुरम् इति ह्य् अस्या आप्त्वा श्रेयांसं वसीयान् आत्मना भवति . गोभिर् भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् इति . यज्ञो वै गोभिर् भङ्गः पशवः परिष्कृतः . यज्ञं चैवैतेन पशूंश् चावरुन्द्धे . इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः इति . यजमानो वै सोमो राजेन्दुस् स्तोमा देवाः .
1.89.m: 'upa asmai gayata narah' (Sing to him, O men!) -- one desiring fame, prosperity, and procreation should use this as the pratipad. It is to this earth that one sings. Everything is indeed upon this earth. One procreates offspring and cattle upon this earth -- he who knows thus. Nara indeed means the divine people; the ksatra is Soma Indu. By this one secures both the vis and the ksatra. 'abhi devam iyaksate' (They approach the god reverently) -- by this one worships all the deities without obstacle. 'upo su jatam apturam' (Come to the one born, the fulfiller) -- one desiring offspring should use this as the pratipad. One procreates offspring and cattle upon oneself. One should use this same pratipad the following day. For through 'apturam' (the fulfiller) one becomes better and wealthier. 'gobhir bhangam pariskrtam' (Adorned with cows, the portion) -- the sacrifice is indeed the 'bhanga' with cows, the cattle are what adorns it. By this one secures both the sacrifice and cattle. 'indum deva ayasisuh' (The gods desired the drop) -- the sacrificer is Soma the King, Indu; the stomas are the gods.

1.90.s: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ iti śraiṣṭhyakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tā enaṃ sṛṣṭā nāpācāyan . so 'kāmayata śraiṣṭhyam āsāṃ prajānāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etāṃ pratipadam apaśyat . tayāstuta . tato vai sa tāsāṃ prajānāṃ śraiṣṭhyam agacchat . gacchati svānāṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . eṣo ha vai samṛddhā stotriyā yasyai pavasva ityārambhaḥ . samṛddhayaivāsya stotriyayā stutaṃ bhavati . yo vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ veda pra mithunena jāyate . pavasva iti ca vācaḥ iti ca daivyaṃ mithunam . pra mithunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda . sarveṣāṃ vā eṣā trayāṇāṃ sāmnāṃ pratipat pavasva iti vāmadevyasya vācaḥ iti rathantarasya agriyaḥ iti bṛhataḥ . sarveṣām asya sāmnāṃ pratipadā stutaṃ bhavati . soma citrābhir ūtibhiḥ iti somo vai devānāṃ citraṃ somenaiva devānāṃ citreṇa bahur bhavati prajāyate .
1.90.d: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः इति श्रैष्ठ्यकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . ता एनं सृष्टा नापाचायन् . सो ऽकामयत श्रैष्ठ्यम् आसां प्रजानां गच्छेयम् इति . स एतां प्रतिपदम् अपश्यत् . तयास्तुत . ततो वै स तासां प्रजानां श्रैष्ठ्यम् अगच्छत् . गच्छति स्वानां श्रैष्ठ्यं य एवं वेद . एषो ह वै समृद्धा स्तोत्रिया यस्यै पवस्व इत्यारम्भः . समृद्धयैवास्य स्तोत्रियया स्तुतं भवति . यो वै दैव्यं मिथुनं वेद प्र मिथुनेन जायते . पवस्व इति च वाचः इति च दैव्यं मिथुनम् . प्र मिथुनेन जायते य एवं वेद . सर्वेषां वा एषा त्रयाणां साम्नां प्रतिपत् पवस्व इति वामदेव्यस्य वाचः इति रथन्तरस्य अग्रियः इति बृहतः . सर्वेषाम् अस्य साम्नां प्रतिपदा स्तुतं भवति . सोम चित्राभिर् ऊतिभिः इति सोमो वै देवानां चित्रं सोमेनैव देवानां चित्रेण बहुर् भवति प्रजायते .
1.90.m: 'pavasva vaco agriyah' (Flow forth, O foremost of speech!) -- one desiring preeminence should use this as the pratipad. Prajapati created creatures. Those creatures, when created, did not honor him. He desired: 'May I attain preeminence among these creatures.' He saw this pratipad. He praised with it. Thereby he attained preeminence among those creatures. He attains preeminence among his own -- he who knows thus. This is indeed the complete stotriya, whose beginning is 'pavasva.' His praise is done with a complete stotriya. He who knows the divine couple procreates through the couple. 'pavasva' and 'vacah' are the divine couple. He procreates through the couple -- he who knows thus. This is the pratipad of all three samans: 'pavasva' belongs to the vamadeya, 'vacah' to the rathantara, 'agriyah' to the brhat. His praise is accomplished with the pratipad of all the samans. 'soma citrabhir utibhih' (Soma, with brilliant aids) -- Soma is indeed the marvelous among the gods; by Soma, the marvelous of the gods, one becomes abundant, one procreates.

1.91.s: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ iti jane pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . kṛdhī no yaśaso janaḥ iti hy asyai yaśasy eva jane bhavati . vṛṣā sutaḥ iti vṛṣeva vai prajanitevādhipatir iva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bhavati yasyām ṛdhyate . vṛṣevaiva prajanitevādhipatir iva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bhāti yasyāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sarvo ha vai jane bubhūṣate 'rātīyati . viśvā apa dviṣo jahi iti viśvā evaitena dviṣo 'pahate . tayā pavasva dhārayā iti saṃgrāmaṃ saṃyatiṣyamānasya pratipadaṃ kuryāt . yayā gāva ihāgaman janyāsa upa no gṛhān iti janyā vā eṣa gā ājihīrṣati yas saṃgrāmaṃ saṃyatate . ā janyā gā harati . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvīta saniṃ praiṣyan . janyā vā eṣa gā ājihīrṣati yas saniṃ praiti . ā janyā gā haraty upainaṃ janyā gāvo namanti ya evaṃ veda . agna āyūṃṣi pavase ity āmayāvinaḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . agniṃ vā etasya śarīram apyeti vāyuṃ prāṇaḥ . agninaivāsya pavamānena śarīraṃ prāṇena saṃdadhāti . etām evaṃ pratipadaṃ kurvīran yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate . apūtā iva vā ete 'medhyā manyante yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate .
1.91.d: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः इति जने प्रतिष्ठाकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . कृधी नो यशसो जनः इति ह्य् अस्यै यशस्य् एव जने भवति . वृषा सुतः इति वृषेव वै प्रजनितेवाधिपतिर् इव तस्यां जनतायां भवति यस्याम् ऋध्यते . वृषेवैव प्रजनितेवाधिपतिर् इव तस्यां जनतायां भाति यस्यां भवति य एवं वेद . सर्वो ह वै जने बुभूषते ऽरातीयति . विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि इति विश्वा एवैतेन द्विषो ऽपहते . तया पवस्व धारया इति संग्रामं संयतिष्यमानस्य प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . यया गाव इहागमन् जन्यास उप नो गृहान् इति जन्या वा एष गा आजिहीर्षति यस् संग्रामं संयतते . आ जन्या गा हरति . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत सनिं प्रैष्यन् . जन्या वा एष गा आजिहीर्षति यस् सनिं प्रैति . आ जन्या गा हरत्य् उपैनं जन्या गावो नमन्ति य एवं वेद . अग्न आयूंषि पवसे इत्य् आमयाविनः प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . अग्निं वा एतस्य शरीरम् अप्येति वायुं प्राणः . अग्निनैवास्य पवमानेन शरीरं प्राणेन संदधाति . एताम् एवं प्रतिपदं कुर्वीरन् येषां दीक्षितानां प्रमीयते . अपूता इव वा एते ऽमेध्या मन्यन्ते येषां दीक्षितानां प्रमीयते .
1.91.m: 'pavasvendo vrsa sutah' (Flow, O drop, pressed out as bull!) -- one desiring firm establishment among people should use this as the pratipad. 'krdhi no yasaso jane' (Make us famous among the people) -- for through this one becomes famous among the people. 'vrsa sutah' (the bull pressed out) -- like a bull, like a progenitor, like a chief, he becomes in that community in which he prospers. Like a bull, like a progenitor, like a chief, he shines in that community in which he lives -- he who knows thus. Everyone indeed desires to thrive among the people and gives gifts. 'visva apa dviso jahi' (Strike away all hatreds!) -- by this one strikes away all hatreds. 'taya pavasva dharaya' (With that stream flow forth!) -- one should use this as the pratipad for one about to engage in battle. 'yaya gava ihagaman janyasa upa no grhan' (By which the cows came here, of foreign people, to our houses) -- he who goes to battle indeed wishes to seize the foreign cows. He seizes the foreign cows. One should use this same pratipad when about to go on a raid. He who goes on a raid indeed wishes to seize the foreign cows. He seizes the foreign cows; the foreign cows bow down to him -- he who knows thus. 'agna ayumsi pavase' (O Agni, you purify lifespans) -- one should use this as the pratipad for one who is ill. For Agni is what his body comes to, Vayu is what his breath comes to. By Agni, the pavamana, one joins together his body and his breath. One should use this same pratipad for those among the consecrated who have died. For those among the consecrated who have died consider themselves as if unpurified, impure.

1.92.s: - brahmavarcasakāmaḥ . agnir vai devānāṃ brahmā . agninaiva devānāṃ brahmaṇā varcasī bhavati . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvītābhicaran . agnir vai devānāṃ brahmā . agninaiva devānāṃ brahmaṇā yaṃ dveṣṭi taṃ stṛṇute . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvītānnādyakāmaḥ . ā suvorjam iṣaṃ ca naḥ iti hy asyā iṣaṃ caivaitenorjaṃ cāvarunddhe . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvītābhicaryamāṇaḥ . yo vā abhicarati yo 'bhidāsati yaḥ pāpaṃ kāmayate sa vai ducchunaḥ . āre bādhasva ducchunām ity ārād evaitena dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyam avāñcam apabādhate . davidyutatyā rucā iti brahmavarcasakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . davidyutatī vai gāyatrī . gāyatrī brahmavarcasam ojo vīryaṃ triṣṭup prajananaṃ jagatī . brahmavarcasy ojasvī vīryavān prajayā paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda . pariṣṭobhantyā kṛpā somāś śukrā gavāśiraḥ iti . yajño vai somāś śukrāḥ paśavo gavāśiraḥ . yajñaṃ caivaitena paśūṃś cāvarunddhe . asya pratnām anu dyutam iti pratipadaṃ kurvīta yasya pitā vā pitāmaho vā śreyān syād athātmanā pāpīyān iva manyeta . yaivāsya pitryā paitāmahī śrīs tām evāśnute . śukraṃ duduhre ahrayaḥ iti . yajño vai śukraḥ paśavo 'hrayaḥ . yajñaṃ caivaitena paśūṃś cāvarunddhe . payas sahasrasām ṛṣim iti .
1.92.d: - ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः . अग्निर् वै देवानां ब्रह्मा . अग्निनैव देवानां ब्रह्मणा वर्चसी भवति . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीताभिचरन् . अग्निर् वै देवानां ब्रह्मा . अग्निनैव देवानां ब्रह्मणा यं द्वेष्टि तं स्तृणुते . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीतान्नाद्यकामः . आ सुवोर्जम् इषं च नः इति ह्य् अस्या इषं चैवैतेनोर्जं चावरुन्द्धे . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीताभिचर्यमाणः . यो वा अभिचरति यो ऽभिदासति यः पापं कामयते स वै दुच्छुनः . आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् इत्य् आराद् एवैतेन द्विषन्तं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यम् अवाञ्चम् अपबाधते . दविद्युतत्या रुचा इति ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . दविद्युतती वै गायत्री . गायत्री ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ओजो वीर्यं त्रिष्टुप् प्रजननं जगती . ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् ओजस्वी वीर्यवान् प्रजया पशुभिर् जायते य एवं वेद . परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा सोमाश् शुक्रा गवाशिरः इति . यज्ञो वै सोमाश् शुक्राः पशवो गवाशिरः . यज्ञं चैवैतेन पशूंश् चावरुन्द्धे . अस्य प्रत्नाम् अनु द्युतम् इति प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत यस्य पिता वा पितामहो वा श्रेयान् स्याद् अथात्मना पापीयान् इव मन्येत . यैवास्य पित्र्या पैतामही श्रीस् ताम् एवाश्नुते . शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः इति . यज्ञो वै शुक्रः पशवो ऽह्रयः . यज्ञं चैवैतेन पशूंश् चावरुन्द्धे . पयस् सहस्रसाम् ऋषिम् इति .
1.92.m: One desiring brahmavarcas should use this. Agni is indeed the brahman among the gods. By Agni, the brahman of the gods, one becomes resplendent. One should use this same pratipad when practicing sorcery. Agni is indeed the brahman among the gods. By Agni, the brahman of the gods, one subdues whomever one hates. One should use this same pratipad when desiring food. 'a suvorjam isam ca nah' (Bring us vigor and nourishment!) -- for through this one secures both nourishment and vigor. One should use this same pratipad when being attacked by sorcery. He who practices sorcery, he who attacks, he who desires evil -- he is indeed inauspicious. 'are badhasva ducchunam' (Drive away the inauspicious one far off!) -- by this one drives away far off the hating rival, the evil one, downward. 'davidyutatya ruca' (With flashing splendor) -- one desiring brahmavarcas should use this as the pratipad. The gayatri is indeed flashing. The gayatri is brahmavarcas; vigor and strength are the tristubh; procreation is the jagati. One becomes endowed with brahmavarcas, vigor, strength, offspring, and cattle -- he who knows thus. 'paristobhantya krpa somaas sukra gavasirah' (The bright somas, mixed with milk, resound on all sides) -- the sacrifice is indeed the bright somas; cattle are what is mixed with milk. By this one secures both the sacrifice and cattle. 'asya pratnam anu dyutam' (Following his ancient splendor) -- one should use this as the pratipad he whose father or grandfather was more eminent, but who considers himself inferior. He attains that very paternal and ancestral glory. 'sukram duduhre ahrayah' (The unblushing ones milked forth the bright one) -- the sacrifice is indeed the bright one; cattle are the unblushing ones. By this one secures both the sacrifice and cattle. 'payas sahasrasam rsim' (The milk, the thousandfold rsi).

1.93.s: ete asṛgram indavaḥ iti bahūnāṃ saṃyajamānānāṃ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . ete ity evainān jyaiṣṭhyāyābhivadati chandasaivainān rūpiṇā samāvadbhājaḥ karoti . samāvaty enān yajñasyāśīr āgacchati . prajāpatir yat prajā asṛjata tā enayaiva pratipadāsṛjata . ete ity eva devān asṛjata asṛgram iti manuṣyān indavaḥ iti pitr̥̄n tiraḥ pavitram iti grahān āśavaḥ iti stomān viśvāni ity ukthāni abhi saubhagā ity evainān jātān saubhāgyenābhyānak . prajāpatir eva bhūtaḥ prajās sṛjate ya evaṃ vidvān etayā pratipadodgāyati . atho hainās tat saubhāgyenaivābhyānakti . asṛkṣata pra vājinaḥ iti trayāṇāṃ saṃyajamānānāṃ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . chandasaivainān rūpiṇā samāvadbhājaḥ karoti . samāvaty enān yajñasyāśīr āgacchati . gavyā somāso aśvayā iti goaśvam evaibhya etenāvarunddhe . śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ iti yajño vai śukraḥ prajā vīro yajñaṃ caivaibhya etena prajāṃ cāvarunddhe . yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svaḥpatī iti dvayos samyajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . chandasaivainau rūpiṇā samāvadbhājau karoti .
1.93.d: एते असृग्रम् इन्दवः इति बहूनां संयजमानानां प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . एते इत्य् एवैनान् ज्यैष्ठ्यायाभिवदति छन्दसैवैनान् रूपिणा समावद्भाजः करोति . समावत्य् एनान् यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छति . प्रजापतिर् यत् प्रजा असृजत ता एनयैव प्रतिपदासृजत . एते इत्य् एव देवान् असृजत असृग्रम् इति मनुष्यान् इन्दवः इति पित्र्̥̄न् तिरः पवित्रम् इति ग्रहान् आशवः इति स्तोमान् विश्वानि इत्य् उक्थानि अभि सौभगा इत्य् एवैनान् जातान् सौभाग्येनाभ्यानक् . प्रजापतिर् एव भूतः प्रजास् सृजते य एवं विद्वान् एतया प्रतिपदोद्गायति . अथो हैनास् तत् सौभाग्येनैवाभ्यानक्ति . असृक्षत प्र वाजिनः इति त्रयाणां संयजमानानां प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . छन्दसैवैनान् रूपिणा समावद्भाजः करोति . समावत्य् एनान् यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छति . गव्या सोमासो अश्वया इति गोअश्वम् एवैभ्य एतेनावरुन्द्धे . शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः इति यज्ञो वै शुक्रः प्रजा वीरो यज्ञं चैवैभ्य एतेन प्रजां चावरुन्द्धे . युवं हि स्थः स्वःपती इति द्वयोस् सम्यजमानयोः प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . छन्दसैवैनौ रूपिणा समावद्भाजौ करोति .
1.93.m: 'ete asrgram indavah' (These drops have flowed forth) -- one should use this as the pratipad when many are sacrificing together. With 'ete' (these) he addresses them for preeminence; he makes them sharers in it through the metre endowed with form. The blessing of the sacrifice comes to them together. When Prajapati created creatures, he created them with this very pratipad. With 'ete' (these) he created the gods; with 'asrgram' (they flowed forth) the humans; with 'indavah' (the drops) the fathers; with 'tirah pavitram' (through the filter) the cups; with 'asavah' (the swift ones) the stomas; with 'visvani' (all) the ukthas; with 'abhi saubhaga' (toward good fortune) he anointed them, once born, with good fortune. Prajapati himself, having become, creates creatures -- he who, knowing thus, chants the udgitha with this pratipad. And thereby he anoints them with good fortune. 'asrksata pra vajinah' (The swift ones flowed forth) -- one should use this as the pratipad when three are sacrificing together. He makes them sharers through the metre endowed with form. The blessing of the sacrifice comes to them together. 'gavya somaso asvaya' (The somas desiring cows, desiring horses) -- by this one secures for them cows and horses. 'sukraso virayasavah' (The bright ones, swiftly seeking heroes) -- the sacrifice is indeed the bright one; the offspring is the hero. By this one secures for them both the sacrifice and offspring. 'yuvam hi sthah svahpati' (For you two are lords of well-being) -- one should use this as the pratipad when two are sacrificing together. He makes them sharers through the metre endowed with form.

1.94.s: indraś ca soma gopatī īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ iti . indraś ca vai somaś cākāmayetāṃ sarvāsāṃ prajānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam aśnuvīvahīti . tāv etāṃ pratipadam apaśyatām . tayāstuvatām . tato vai tau sarvāsāṃ prajānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam āśnuvātām . aśnute ha vai svānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam etayā pratipadā tuṣṭuvānaḥ . indrāyendo marutvate iti rājanyabandhoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . aindro vai rājanyo mārutīr viśaḥ . kṣatrāyaiva tad viśam anuvartmānaṃ kurvanti . tasmāt kṣatrasya viḍ anuvartmā . yo jināti na jīyate iti vā jināty eva na jīyate . hanti śatrum abhītya ity anyato vātyevābhītya śatruṃ hanti nainaṃ śatruḥ pratyudyāmī bhavati . sa pavasva sahasrajit iti . yo vai sarvaṃ jayati vijayate saḥ . sarvajit sarvam eva jayati .
1.94.d: इन्द्रश् च सोम गोपती ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः इति . इन्द्रश् च वै सोमश् चाकामयेतां सर्वासां प्रजानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यम् अश्नुवीवहीति . ताव् एतां प्रतिपदम् अपश्यताम् . तयास्तुवताम् . ततो वै तौ सर्वासां प्रजानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यम् आश्नुवाताम् . अश्नुते ह वै स्वानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यम् एतया प्रतिपदा तुष्टुवानः . इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते इति राजन्यबन्धोः प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . ऐन्द्रो वै राजन्यो मारुतीर् विशः . क्षत्रायैव तद् विशम् अनुवर्त्मानं कुर्वन्ति . तस्मात् क्षत्रस्य विड् अनुवर्त्मा . यो जिनाति न जीयते इति वा जिनात्य् एव न जीयते . हन्ति शत्रुम् अभीत्य इत्य् अन्यतो वात्येवाभीत्य शत्रुं हन्ति नैनं शत्रुः प्रत्युद्यामी भवति . स पवस्व सहस्रजित् इति . यो वै सर्वं जयति विजयते सः . सर्वजित् सर्वम् एव जयति .
1.94.m: 'indras ca soma gopati isana pipyatam dhiyah' (Indra and Soma, lords of cattle, inspiring, nourish the hymns!) -- Indra and Soma desired: 'May we attain the sovereignty and lordship over all creatures.' They saw this pratipad. They praised with it. Thereby they attained the sovereignty and lordship over all creatures. He attains sovereignty and lordship over his own -- he who praises with this pratipad, knowing thus. 'indrayendo marutvate' (For Indra accompanied by the Maruts, O drop!) -- one should use this as the pratipad for a rajanyabandhu (one connected to the ksatriya class). The rajanya belongs to Indra; the vis (people) belong to the Maruts. One thereby makes the vis follow the ksatra. Therefore the vis follows the ksatra. 'yo jinati na jiyate' (He who conquers and is not conquered) -- he conquers and is not conquered. 'hanti satrum abhitya' (He slays the enemy, having approached) -- having approached from wherever, he slays the enemy; the enemy does not become one who advances against him. 'sa pavasva sahasrajit' (Flow forth, O thousand-conquering one!) -- he who conquers everything is the one who conquers all. He conquers all, he conquers everything.
